question: In Table 1, what carrier does NCP-CD47 siRNA use, which institution runs its trial, and what is the trial's status?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p2.T1' AND row_no IN (SELECT row_no FROM cells WHERE table_id='p2.T1' AND text ILIKE '%CD47%') ORDER BY row_no, col_no
SELECT id, row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p2.T1' AND row_no BETWEEN 19 AND 23 ORDER BY row_no, col_no

SELECT id, text, x0, top FROM lines WHERE page=2 AND (text ILIKE '%non-%' OR text ILIKE '%cationic%' OR text ILIKE '%peptide%' OR text ILIKE '%CD47%' OR text ILIKE '%West China%' OR text ILIKE '%recruiting%') ORDER BY top

SELECT id, text FROM atoms WHERE page=2 AND (text ILIKE '%non-%' OR text ILIKE '%cationic%' OR text ILIKE '%peptide%' OR text ILIKE '%CD47%' OR text ILIKE '%West China%' OR text ILIKE '%recruiting%' OR text ILIKE '%NCT07583914%') ORDER BY top
SELECT row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p2.T1' AND row_no BETWEEN 14 AND 26 ORDER BY row_no, col_no
